title: 較正・CV準備・帯出力の容量改良受入
status: B1-B4 implemented and locally accepted; real observations, remote CI, publication and SDK integration remain

units.title: 較正予測のbatch化
changes: surrogate較正は一度のprediction iteratorを消費。全較正field予測を保持しない。
simultaneousはsample最大score、pointwiseは正確rankに必要な小さい側のtailだけ保持。既存array fitはpointwise座標block方式を維持。
channel正規化のmaskをbatch内へ限定。新YAML・近似・一時disk・再推論は追加しない。
units.acceptance: 新旧threshold/half_width/scaleの差0。独立sort oracleで全rank/grid/meshの672ケース成功。

units.title: CV baseline準備の不要copy撤去
changes: mean_field_predictionへ親Dataset indicesを渡し、小さいbatchだけをgatherして同じunweighted training meanを計算。
baselineのためだけの全fit field subsetを削除。既存pooled objectiveと元点stencil再利用を維持。

units.title: 未使用の全件帯保持を撤去
changes: coverage reportは小さいsample統計だけ保持。unused _evaluate/return_intervals分岐とwrite_predictions wrapperを削除。
finalizationは既存query batch内で帯を生成し共通writerへ渡す。file-only inferenceは既存stream経路を維持。
units.acceptance: 64x512x512x1で全帯保持268.4MBから0、peak約254MB減。coverage/per-sample/全3数値NPY bytes一致。出力再計算の時間増を記録。

units.title: 単体配布・仕様の同期
changes: 0.10.2 wheelをbuildし既存isolated base環境へ再インストール。不要旧wheelは比較基準へ保持後distから削除。
package READMEの古いschema2説明をschema3/旧1,2互換へ訂正。新API・必要容量・tradeoffを既存guideへ集約。
units.acceptance: development597pass/3skip、installed567pass/33skip、旧14bundle、source105files一致、原入力67件不変、別process推論成功。

findings: 較正のbatch reductions前に全件予測をmaterializeしていた。
CV baselineだけのために全fit field subsetを作成していた。
解析reportが未使用の全下限/上限を保持し、最終出力もsliceのためだけに全帯を保持していた。
配布package READMEのschema2説明が現schema3と齟齬を起こしていた。

acceptance.skip_reasons: development: 3 optional backend cases; installed: 19 optional backend and 14 producer-Python-minor cases
acceptance.legacy_models: actual 0.7.1 eight bundles and actual 0.9.0 six bundles pass in matching producer environment

calibration.method: One independent Windows process per version and scope, generated capacity data, one numerical thread. Process peak includes fitting; calibration time is one cold call. Capacity reduction trades additional exact-tail partition work in pointwise; no universal speedup claim.

cv_preparation.scope: Generated 96 x 384 x 384 x 2 float32 masked input; three preparation calls per separate version process; one numerical thread. Whole CV trials and model fitting are not measured. Pooled validation truth/support still reside in memory.
cv_preparation.interpretation: Peak working set decreased about 130 MB; measured preparation time increased about 4 percent. No end-to-end speedup or full out-of-core CV claim. The shared pooled validation truth/support and model-fitting arrays are unchanged.

band_output.scope: Synthetic fixed fields and accepted reporting/output functions, one process per version; excludes model fitting and point prediction. No full-pipeline out-of-core claim.
band_output.tradeoff: Coverage statistics retain no full bands. Final output recalculates endpoints one bounded batch at a time, taking an additional pass and longer measured output time. Array APIs still return full requested arrays. Generated 402.7 MB output collections were removed after recording hashes; harness and measurements remain.

independent_calibration_review.normalization: channel, including a constant training channel using unit scale
independent_calibration_review.inputs: Read-only strided truth/predictions, positive-measure support, zero weights, excluded domain, NaN outside support, random outer batch lengths and small internal chunk threshold.
independent_calibration_review.review: The lower tail retains rank smallest values; the upper tail negates scores and retains n-rank+1 smallest negatives. After merging each batch, the retained maximum selects the exact requested full-sort rank. No interpolation or rank approximation.
independent_calibration_review.remaining_capacity: Pointwise persistent tail is min(rank,n-rank+1) x support x channels; its buffer adds up to the current bounded prediction chunk, and growth temporarily keeps old/new buffers. Half-width, model state, input truth and one large field remain resident. Near median rank the exact tail can remain large.

cleanup: Deleted unused full-band report storage and return_intervals/_evaluate branch.
Deleted unused write_predictions wrapper; direct file inference already streams.
Removed baseline-only full fit subset and full calibration predictions.
Deleted obsolete dist 0.10.1 wheel after retaining and SHA-verifying immutable baseline.
Removed large generated output comparison arrays after byte/hash comparison; retained small records and reproduction harness.
No generic DAG, state-machine, new YAML switches, hash contracts or structural tests added. Necessary scientific and compatibility tests retained.
Previously rejected wheel_env recursive deletion was not retried; environment reused for acceptance.
remaining: Real observation/future truth/actual physics boundary acceptance with workload-specific time, RSS and temporary disk.
Remote Linux/Windows CI and publication destination; current local checks are not remote execution.
Pooled CV truth/support, dense/global SVD, joint/EM, GP, exact pointwise tail and array-return APIs retain necessary capacity. Optimize only measured dominant paths.

Arbitrary-point calibrated bands, condition/dependence-aware calibration, arbitrary PDE, 3D/moving geometry and neutral long-term persistence remain separately scoped; SDK reintegration follows standalone acceptance.
